decks.notes: The deck focuses on using a variety of creatures to assemble combos that generate value and control the board. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Walking Ballista to create powerful synergies. The toolbox aspect allows for flexibility in finding the right creatures for the situation, while also providing ways to generate card advantage and disrupt opponents. The inclusion of Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Malevolent Rumble adds additional layers of control and disruption to the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through creature-based combos and synergies.

The main concept of this Aggro-Hollow One deck is to utilize cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Hollow One, Vengevine, and Detective's Phoenix. By using cards like Blazing Rootwalla and Marauding Mako to apply pressure on the opponent early game, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Additional cards like Lightning Bolt and Practiced Offense provide additional reach and versatility in combat. The deck aims to be fast-paced, aggressive, and disruptive to catch the opponent off guard and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and using them to generate a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal, the deck can quickly ramp and build up its artifact count. Key cards like Engineered Explosives and Claws of Gix provide removal options, while cards like Shadowspear and Weapons Manufacturing offer additional utility and ways to push damage through. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Pinnacle Emissary provide additional recursion and card advantage, helping to maintain momentum throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate a large amount of mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Karn, the Great Creator to dominate the battlefield. The deck also utilizes Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Devourer of Destiny to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Chalice of the Void and All Is Dust provide additional control elements to ensure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate powerful synergies and overwhelm opponents. Using cards like Kozilek's Command, Malevolent Rumble, and Unholy Heat to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans, while also utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End for additional threats. The deck aims to create a strong board presence through its combos and control elements, ultimately leading to victory through overwhelming force and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through Eldrazi Temples and Gemstone Caverns to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board while generating mana with Disciple of Freyalise and Sowing Mycospawn. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large, hard-to-answer threats while also disrupting their strategy with spells like Fight Rigging and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck aims to quickly establish board control and win the game through powerful Eldrazi creatures.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan by countering their spells and removing their threats with cards like Counterspell, Force of Negation, Fatal Push, and Archmage's Charm. It also aims to draw cards and gain card advantage through cards like Lórien Revealed and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck includes powerful threats such as Namor the Sub-Mariner and Thundertrap Trainer to close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements with fetch lands and dual lands.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. The strategy revolves around setting up the combo pieces in the graveyard and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to protect the combo. Otherworldly Gaze and Meticulous Archive help set up the graveyard while Prismatic Ending and Solitude handle opposing threats. The deck aims to win the game quickly through its explosive reanimation strategy.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counter spells, removal, and creature control. The deck focuses on efficiently controlling the board while maintaining card advantage and tempo advantage. It also includes a few finishers and threats to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been exhausted. The deck aims to control the game from start to finish, using a mix of instant-speed spells and powerful creatures to dictate the pace of the game.

This deck aims to control the game through powerful Eldrazi creatures and disruption spells while assembling the UrzaTron lands for massive mana advantage. By utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms, the deck can lock down opponents and control the board state. Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker provide additional disruption, while Emrakul, the Promised End can close out games quickly. The deck also includes various utility spells and artifacts to deal with a variety of threats and strategies, making it a versatile and adaptive control deck.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan through land destruction and removal spells. It aims to slow down the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources to eventually overwhelm them with powerful creatures and spells. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds additional value and synergy to the deck, enhancing its control capabilities. Overall, the deck seeks to efficiently manage the battlefield and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory in 1 vs 1 Modern matches.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creature cards that work together to create powerful combos. The deck utilizes cards like Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures, such as Cauldron Familiar and Gilded Goose, which can be sacrificed for value with cards like Viscera Seer and Carrion Feeder. With cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Witherbloom Charm providing additional utility and removal options, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging its versatile creature lineup.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to dominate the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Spell Snare helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also has a solid mana base with dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and powerful late-game plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the game with powerful Eldrazi creatures while ramping up mana quickly to play them ahead of schedule. It uses ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate into big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. Removal spells like Unholy Heat and Kozilek's Command help control the board while Malevolent Rumble deals damage to opposing creatures. The deck also includes cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Formidable Speaker to generate additional resources and maintain card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly tutor for and play Allosaurus Rider as a big creature, which can then be sacrificed to Neoform or Eldritch Evolution to bring out a powerful creature like Griselbrand or Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck utilizes cards like Xenagos, God of Revels and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to enhance the power of these creatures, while also utilizing counter spells like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer for protection. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a game-winning combo.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Allosaurus Combo by using cards like Allosaurus Rider, Eldritch Evolution, and Neoform to cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck also includes a toolbox of spells like Summoner's Pact and Pact of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt opposing strategies. The inclusion of Nourishing Shoal and Veil of Summer helps the deck to interact with the opponent and stay ahead in the game. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and explosive creature plays.
